title: AEG Turbine Factory
scope: The surviving Behrens and Bernhard AEG Turbine Hall including its attached low west aisle and 1939–40 north extension in Berlin-Moabit.
limitations: The 28 m original roof crest follows the published architectural study. Steel bay spacing and glazing details use the Qualla view.
The building model includes the attached aisle and the mapped standing extension. Side-yard service façades and roofing details are approximate.
Scope covers the Turbine Hall and its attached volumes. Separate offices and neighboring factories are outside this asset.
